title: Customer pages carry the SEO tags
problem: Only store pages had a customer page; none wrote their SEO into the page head.
now: Pages, posts, products, categories and landing pages each have a customer page with one set of SEO tags.
steps: Open a product's View on the website.
Inspect the page head: one title, description, canonical and schema.
notes: Where: /page, /blog-post, /product, /category, /lp · Needs the server: Search engines read the HTML the server sends; here the tags are added after the page loads. The server must write them.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
